name: zAI-Skills
description: Claude Code plugins for prompt engineering and ML work (ai-toolkit), sourced consulting deliverables (consulting-toolkit), real estate investment analysis (real-estate-investment), job search (career-coach), and eval-first plugin building (plugin-forge)

plugins.name: ai-toolkit
plugins.description: Prompt engineering for current Claude models, Python and C++ reinforcement learning, Keras 3 deep learning, x402 payments, and OpenClaw setup: 6 skills, 4 commands and 2 agents.

plugins.name: consulting-toolkit
plugins.description: Consulting deliverables with every number sourced: 17 commands (issue trees, market sizing, profiles, business cases, storylines, partner review), an /engagement orchestrator with 5 agents, and an 8-tool financial data server for SEC filings, FRED and stock prices.

plugins.name: real-estate-investment
plugins.description: Real estate investment analysis: deal analysis and screening, pro formas from tested scripts, BRRRR, STR, market comparison, waterfalls, portfolio and exit planning, and real estate tax strategy. 4 agents, 9 commands, and an MCP server with 13 tools across 7 data sources (Redfin needs no key; Census and FRED keys are free).

plugins.name: career-coach
plugins.description: Job-search help from resume import to offer: a career profile built from your resume, ranked job searches with skill matching, tailored resumes and cover letters, mock interviews, application tracking and offer comparison. 8 commands, 3 agents, and a 5-tool job-data server.

plugins.name: plugin-forge
plugins.description: Eval-first plugin builder: primitive decision records, generated eval suites with arming gates, sha256-frozen contracts, goal-loop builds in isolated worktrees, verified ships. The suite is the contract; green is the definition of done.
